item.title: (Seeking Greenlight) The First and Forever Prisoner
item.description: The history of SCP-682 and all those who have imprisoned it.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: Tale

Genre: History

Elevator Pitch: Following the history of the one we know as SCP-682 from it's birth as a child of the Scarlet King, exiled to Earth until she could kill everyone, to being an inmate in Titania's Prison, to trying to release it's father only to be imprisoned by the Keepers. The only thing stopping it from detroying the world has been the legacy of the Jailors that have kept it imprisoned for most of it's existence, the Foundation is only the most recent to inherit the role.

Central Narrative: Connecting the dots between several hints regarding 682
- born as A'zieb, the fourth child/bride of the Scarlet King
- Mal-Va-Gar-Ta-Mor, SCP-2932-A, first imprisonment under the Children of the Night and the Hudaru
- The Bastard Son of Apep, SCP-557-1, the Ancient Containment Site was actually the first version of SCP-2317, the stone in the floor of Room 501 sealing off the Scarlet King(the other door was made later when this way could not be accessed) his fourth child led an army to break his seal only to be imprisoned as well.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: This isn't about killing the Hard-to-Kill Reptile, this is about why it matters that it is contained by the Foundation and it's precursors. Also information on why both the Reptile and the King are not meant to be destroyed at all.

Additional Notes: I am also planning on connecting Mekhane/Wan and/or the Lord of Endowments in this story to tie it to another tale I'm working on. The Gods are critical in sealing and containing the Prisoners.

item.title: SCP-XXXX: Children of the Stars
item.description: Incorporeal beings that possess children in order to walk among humans in order to perform a series of rituals to appease a deity of even higher power than them.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Mystery

Elevator Pitch: Ten individual children have their consciousness taken over by incorporeal beings and become seemingly immortal for reasons that are currently unknown.

Central Narrative: SCP-XXXX, which is not the children but rather what has taken control of the children's consciousness, are interviewed and studied by the researchers. During the interviews, they come to learn that they use the children in order to have a physical body in this reality and to accomplish particular rituals to appease a long overlooked god.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: A possible, yet not direct relation to the Fifth Church and a connection to one of the monolithic figures depicted in one of the murals within SCP-4840.

item.title: SCP-XXXX "The Frozen Wood"
item.description: A snowy, unassuming forest, unable to support life of any kind... Except it's own...
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article, Tale (after SCP is established)

Genre (Optional): Horror, Drama/Emotional

Class: Euclid

Elevator Pitch:

+ show block
– hide block

SCP-XXXX is a snowy, Birch forest varying in size, but often appears in a 10 KM x 12 KM radius. The subject seems to teleport to areas around the world at random (along with anything inside it), leaving a large, empty area in its wake, but is limited to cold climates and/or places that are experiencing severe winter storms. Strangely, the area always seems to be entirely sterile, no life can survive, be it plant, animal, bacteria, or even tardigrade!

Central Narrative:

+ show block
– hide block

The SCP tale I was planning for this follows a lone huntsman as he has unknowingly stumbled into this forest looking for game. He starts feeling weak, his vision blurry, and the snow taking on a slight red-ish hue. He starts coughing up blood, eventually too weak to go any further and contemplates his own mortality as he slowly dies in the snow. A lot of this story will have to do with what goes on in the character's mind, and how he deals with his impending death. (just a summary of the story)

Hook/Attention-Grabber:

+ show block
– hide block

As stated before, the forest cannot support any life whatsoever, except for the trees that grow in it; these trees, designated SCP-XXXX-A, release a toxic, spore-like pollen that sterilizes and kills all known terrestrial lifeforms (many SCP's are not affected), but thankfully, only within it's area of effect. These spores are inhaled and break down the cells of the organism, causing; internal bleeding from torn organ tissue, destruction of muscle fibers/tissue leading to paralysis, vomiting blood, asphyxiation, convulsions and/or seizures, always ending with total organ failure and death.

After tracking it for years and sending hazmat-suit equipped recovery teams into the area, a total of 247 human bodies have been discovered, as well as the corpses of wildlife native to many different regions. Strangely, these bodies were perfectly intact, no decay had occurred as there were no bacteria left to break the bodies down.

Additional Notes:

- The spores from SCP-XXXX-A cannot survive outside of SCP-XXXX's area of effect, thus, the only way to study the spores is to be within the subject itself.

- Due to its often secluded location and it's deadly nature, as long as the Foundation is careful about the spores, a well protected base could be built inside the area as well as utilizing its random teleportation effect to avoid detection by the public!

item.title: SCP-XXXX - The Division Bell
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror/History

Elevator Pitch: An archaic bell that when rung instils extreme feelings of revulsion and loathing towards other humans (to the point of violence)

Central Narrative:
Discovery log - This will describe the findings of the archaeological dig where the bell was found. Summarised:
Discovered in the Fens near Crowland Abbey, England.
Surrounded by human skeletal remains bearing signs of violence (broken bones, crushed skulls, incision marks, burn marks, etc.
Dated to circa 710 CE.
Unusual bronze composition (higher than normal tin percentage; presence of antimony - unknown at time bell casting)
Inscription on bell 'belli munus' (Latin for 'gift of war')
Essentially, the discovery log will hint at something unusual, setting the stage for the incident log, where the anomalous properties were discovered.

Incident log - This will describe what happened when a historical society/museum renovated it and rang it for the first time: all attendees consumed with revulsion and/or loathing, leading to much violence including deaths and serious injuries. Probably a description from security and/or news camera footage at the venue.

+ show block
– hide block

Hook/Attention-Grabber:
Addendum 1 - this will link the bell to Guthlac of Crowland - an ascetic hermit monk who later had an abbey built for him by the king of Mercia, and was said to be plagued by demons (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guthlac_of_Crowland). The implication will be that the demons made him create the bell during his isolation.
Addendum 2 - this will briefly describe some lost notes from the Hemony brothers (real world bell founders from the 1600s), with a design identical to the Fens bell - plus documentation that several of these were manufactured and sold (to unknown parties). And possibly notes for an 'improved' design.

Additional Notes:
I'd like to have a sound clip of the bell to either play automatically a certain amount of time after opening the article (creepy but not really within the SCP format) or after clicking one/many links with appropriate warnings/security credentials ('Confirm level 3 access', 'Confirm you are alone', 'Confirm you are shackled' etc.).

item.title: Lost objects appear at 0°N 0°E (Greenlight)
item.description: Teleportation/time travel tests to unset coordinates cause major explosions when objects overlap.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Anomaly

Page Layout (Optional): Description, table of recovered instances, discovery, addendum with notable events, appendixes with anticipated future events and recommendations.

Elevator Pitch: Objects randomly appear at exactly 0°N 0°E presumably due to teleportation to unset coordinates. The objects intersect with whatever is already there in the ocean in high-energy mergers. Similarly time travel mistakes happen where many objects appear simultaneously at times such the Unix epoch (1970-01-01) and the GPS epoch (1980-01-06) resulting in very large explosions.

Central Narrative: A very large explosion happens at 0°N 0°E on 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC. The Foundation discovers objects randomly appearing there, almost always destroyed by the high-energy intersection with what's already there in the ocean. The objects vary from junk to high tech equipment potentially from the future, accidentally sent to unset coordinates. Further explosions happen during the GPS epochs on 1980-01-01, and 1999-08-21, and the Foundation figures out the computing aspect. The Y2K bug confirms it and the Foundation anticipates further events and mitigates them. It turns out time overflow bugs also caused major explosions back in 1900 and 1901 and more are due in 2036 and 2038. The Foundation recommends switching to better time keeping formats.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Specific containment procedures to stay away from 0°N 0°E (Null Island) with hints of dangerous events that nuclear nations needs to be informed about, a picture of an flaming object manifesting in the ocena.

Additional Notes: I already wrote a complete draft at http://scp-sandbox-3.wikidot.com/sortie but need to go through the greenlight policy as a first time author.

item.title: (Seeking Greenlights and tips!) Portraitly.ai
item.description: A neural network begins whirring out brand-new and completely unique humanoid entities.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror/Sci-Fi

Elevator Pitch:
+Show Elevator Pitch
-Hide Elevator Pitch

An indie neural network project with the purpose of generating human portraits through combining several photographs of different people begins to manifest entities that appear to perfectly match the human shown in the image, except for the absence of any body parts not shown in the image. However, the entities are still able to propel themselves by unknown means. These entities vocalize through a combination of word jumbles composed of both English and French and through EDM bass drop samples. The humanoid entities prove difficult to terminate, as they are able to demanifest their physical form through a crouching motion.

Central Narrative:
+Show Central Narrative
-Hide Central Narrative

SCP-XXXX was first made known to the foundation after a series of reports detailing the sudden manifestation of a disembodied male head outside of the Arvonne Fraser Library in Minneapolis, Minnesota to local authorities. The Minneapolis Police Department passed the reports to the SCP Foundation, which immediately detained the entity and administered amnestics to witnesses of the event as well as propagating an online disinformation campaign, as images of the entity were posted on multiple websites. The entity was then interviewed by the site-19 researcher, Dr. Sharpe. The interview was conducted with the objective of discerning any potential information about the entity that it may be able to convey. Dr. Sharpe ascertained that the entity is capable of simple communication through the use of word association games. During these games, the entity mentions the word "Portraitly" which, after further research into the initial SCP-XXXX event, matched computer browsing history logs from inside the library. The interview was terminated after Dr. Sharpe apparently pointed out a patch of acne under the entity's hairline, which caused the entity to cease cooperation with Dr. Sharpe. The entity is contained in a standard humanoid chamber. Testing of SCP-XXXX determined that Portraitly.ai, a website hosting an anomalous neural network, manifests a seemingly random entity in the area of any subject using the website. Pressing the "Reload" option on Portraitly.ai prompts the website to generate a new image, which in turn manifests a new entity.

Hook/Attention-Grabber:
+Show Hook
-Hide Hook

I haven't seen many SCP articles covering neural network sites, so I think it may be interesting to write about one possibly going wrong, especially with the rise of deep fakes and image generators.

Additional Notes: This is my first SCP pitch, so any critique, greenlights, or, advice would be greatly appreciated!

item.title: Dr wondertainment’s instant clown costume
item.description: This SCP explains the sudden clown fad of 2016 dive in to find out more
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Informative

Elevator Pitch: SCP-XXXX is simply cheap plastic packaging held a single red noes, the cardboard label said ‘Dr. Wondertainment’s instant clown costume’ on it. There were no other writing or label on this packaging, no obvious anomalous properties seem to be apparent of the object until placed upon a person.

Central Narrative: Their skin seemed to be rubber now and cloths have morphed to appear goofy and in character of a clown, the face resembles that of a Halloween clown mask creepy and eerie as you stare into its lifeless rubber eyes, and fake rubber teeth, the noes once placed there cannot be removed and causes individuals to wonder mindlessly around room, cities and forests, grabbing onto any item then can use as weapon including knives, hammers, guns and any other blunt object within grasp, so far these entities have only stood menacingly out of view avoiding human contact walking away when approached never using their threatening objects for harmful reasons, and once morning arrives, they disappear.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: upon observation of a deceased victim of SCP-XXXX they find that the noes overtakes a person, turning skin into that of a cheap Halloween mask rubber, their cloths had been effected as well being overtaken by light fabrics like a cheap costume binding to not only frantic but the skin as well much like it was stitching together

Additional Notes: each face is unique and terrifying, no instant of this SCP has taken a life, but all instances have perished either due to fearful reactions of bystanders shooting in self defense, or long term starvation due to the fact an infected individuals loses the will and ability to eat or drink, more research to be conducted.

item.title: Seeking Greenlight: The Architects Automaton
item.description: An Automaton of unknown origin, inexplicably in operational condition
item.content:encoded:
An Automaton of unknown origin, inexplicably in operational condition. Creates increasingly complex geometric patterns that grab the eye and boggle the mind.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlight: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Cosmic Horror

Elevator Pitch:
SCP-XXXX is a functional Automaton, appearing to be from the 1800s. It resembles a small child writing at a desk, to which it is attached. Upon supplying SCP-XXXX with paper and ink for the attached pen and turning the crank, the crank will lock in place. However, it has been discovered through intense physical manipulation and scientific reasoning, that SCP-XXXX will respond to particular audio frequencies, all of which are outside the audible spectrum. It will then activate autonomously and begin drawing with extreme precision until its internal potential energy is exhausted.

+ show block
– hide block

Central Narrative:
The story laying under the surface of this strange artifact as well as many others that will come is the story of the Architect. A person from an unknown time and place that has found a way to harness mathematics and geometry into a form of literal magic. Though the Architect's whereabouts and physicality are yet unknown, there are many strange, otherworldly objects that lend themselves to prove his existence.

Associate SCP concepts-
- The architect’s Automaton Known
- The arithmetic sigils (x3) Unknown
- The Arithmicon Unknown
- The huntsmen Unknown
- The Lead Knights Unknown
- The Tide Unknown
- The face of god Unknown
- The seed of Eden Unknown
- The black moor Unknown
- The eye of Yog Unknown
- The traveler's cube Unknown

Hook/Attention-Grabber:
The drawings it produces vary wildly dependent on the frequency given to it and will grow in complexity with each subsequent process. It has been noted that attempting to investigate and calculate these geometric patterns will result in Dissociative Amnesia, Psychosis, Dementia, Alzheimer's syndrome, and many other effects. This is seemingly at random, and no two cases are alike but in one distinct factor. Each of the subjects exposed to the drawings seems to experience delusions and dreams of a masked figure cloaked in black.

Additional Notes:
It is not yet known what happens when SCP-XXXX is allowed to finish one of its patterns, but it is certainly best left to conjecture.

item.title: Child of heroes
item.description: A humanoid childlike SCP claiming to annihilate any threat to the earth. However it has no experience doing so or how to deal with it.
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Other? Big Potential threat but not an absolutely terrifying being. I don’t know how to clarify. Government takeover scary and not Monster scary

Elevator Pitch: A child humanoid SCP that possesses anomalous abilities similar to a comic character. Including high levels of strength, agility, along with being able to fire beams from his hand that when observed up close are similar in nature to the state of matter plasma. The SCP claims to be a Hero of justice from another world and has vowed to fight for the safety of this planet. The SCP is aware of every law pertaining to each individual stat and country from sources it refuses to foretell.

Central Narrative: A basic exploration of the idea of if Superman had zero guidance or experience with handling situations becoming who he is. And if it’s relatively agreed that the event would be catastrophic how so? (I swear to God I am not copying off of the kid that can open portals to items he wants. I promise it’s different and good.)

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Most SCP usually have a proper handle on how they work by the time they are in the foundation. The SCP has no idea how to use its anomaly for its said purpose. It is not familiar at all with standard procedure pursuing law breaking or threats of any kind. For example the SCP will attempt to destroy any person breaking these laws and anything in the way of its pursuit. It also has refused to negotiate on any other method of dealing with said criminals with any local authority. The SCP also seems to behave like a child

Additional Notes: The child was sited from a wormhole that opened near the asteroid belt and closed into earth crashing in a forest close enough to the foundation for recovery with minimal complications.

item.title: Seeking Greenlight : The Man with the Bowler Hat
item.description: SCP with extraordinary rhetorical skills and a fascinating bowler hat
item.content:encoded:
Looking for feedback on idea : A SCP with extraordinary rhetorical skills and a fascinating bowler hat.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Horror, Intrigue

Page Layout (Optional): Don't know yet

Elevator Pitch: A man arrives at SCP site XXX by foot, wearing a black coat and a black bowler hat on his head. Guards outside the gates are astonished, they didn't see him coming down the road. The man asks to speak with Director XXXX about something he does not wish to share with personel under level 4 clearance. The guards are surprised ; this man knows the jargon of the Foundation, but who is he? He does not seem to be wearing any badge or signet from any governmental or private corporation. The guards would have normaly turn down any such request coming from a civilian, but something about this man seems peculiar.

Central Narrative: The man is a malignous entity that relies on speech and rhetorical skills to trap humans into mind-wrecking revelations about their lives. He says he has ultimate knowledge on things in the universe, but before answering any questions, the man says he will only answer if he is allowed to ask a question after his answer.

+ show block
– hide block

Eventually, the man tries to find a way to get access to SCP-343, pretending he has old business to take care of with "what the foundation call SCP-343". He also asks to meet all the single SCP kept in this facility. This request is denied, but he seems to already know which SCPs are located into the facility. -(Here I will be provinding discussion log demonstrating the man's ability to use rhetoric and revealing undisclosed information about the foundation. This will serve the idea that he is all-knowing, but takes pleasure in playing with weak minds.)

Hook/Attention-Grabber: This SCP is somewhere between the Keter/Thaumiel class. The man agrees to containement because he let's the foundation keep him : "You and your foundation are only able to contain me because I allow it. Keep asking me questions and I will glady be contained". He does not seem physicaly dangerous, but he is highly dangerous when questions asked to him are poorly developped. Although, if the questions are well developped, then they can reveal extraordinary knowledge about certain SCPs and anomalies. The knowledge of this man is beyond human intelligence. Many researchers try to have "mind" fights with him but they all end up being beaten (and some have their mind's destroyed). I believe the hook would be that the more discussion the foundation researchers have with this man, the more they start believe he is in fact the devil -(I will add theological references and such).

Additional Notes: I would like to get your feedback on this idea and also if you think this is interesting enough to have as a SCP. I really enjoy SCPs that are trickters and that don't seem to be dangerous at first. Feel free to ask questions, I really want to make it as clear as possible! Thanks :)

item.title: Homohelix
item.description: A parasitic anomalous entity that has attached itself in the shape of a helicopter to a normal businessman
item.content:encoded:
A parasitic anomalous entity that has attached itself in the shape of a helicopter to a normal businessman that now searches for money from specific targets.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Sci-Fi

Page Layout (Optional):

Elevator Pitch: A seemingly normal businessman who isn’t abnormal in any way besides the fact that there is a large helicopter attached to its head. The helicopter-headed man seems to have only one purpose, taking money from it’s victims. It has three stages of agitation: pestering with small annoyances(flashing headlights, noises from blades), direct action to things around it’s victim(ramming a dwelling, making obstructions), and hunting to kill the victim. It remains ominously floating in the air at most times. Any attempts to hit the being with anything besides money results in it/them getting sucked into the interior of the helicopter. Eye-witnesses observing from a higher point noted a seeming endless void on the floor of the chopper. Amnestics were administered.

+ show block
– hide block

Central Narrative: The abnormal entity was identified to be Edward Cleary by his mother, Tracey Cleary. After observation in the [redacted] plot, Dr. Wrost and a few colleagues concluded that Edward Cleary was originally a normal man before a parasitic anomalous entity overtook it, hence frying Cleary’s brain and using him as a suitable control unit to take a large physical shape. Mrs. Cleary once flew out to Toronto, Canada in the early stages of its appearance before it was being contained by the foundation, to meet with her son. After attempts to bring down the anomalous entity to the ground her left arm was ripped off and consumed by the void. Questions ensued and then amnestics were administered. Almost immediately after, Site [redacted] sent out a squad of field agents to lure the anomalous being back to a controlled area of wilderness where some D-Class Personnel to contain it. Test results show that some body parts are functional (fingers, mouth), while others are not(legs, eyes).

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I’ve scoured the website a bit, and you don’t see a parasitic SCP that often, so expanding on this could lead to some interesting things. The idea of something growing on a normal man’s head and creating an abomination such as a helicopter-headed abnormality is something that I think the community could take a long way.

Additional Notes: With something as odd as this, an image would definitely be necessary, so I might photoshop one up or have a friend draw one. The fine details would be smoothed out by the end draft, I already have ideas for it’s containment.

item.title: The Foundation in a post-America world
item.description: Tale: The Foundation's Contingency for the collapse of the United States of America
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes.

Page type: Tale.

Genre: Speculative Internal Document.

Page layout: Internal contingency plan in the form of an essay detailing foundation response to the crisis, interspersed with dialogue between characters on the proposals.

Elevator Pitch: The Foundation's internal plan to deal with a collapse of the Federal Government's control over America into a multi-party civil war (closer to the Syrian civil war than the American 1863).

+ show block
– hide block

Central Narrative: After a short section on assumptions for the scenario (Government control over large portions of the country has been lost, insurrection is in multiple, decentralized factions all over the country, etc), the document will describe the foundation's priorities and what actions should be taken towards them in this scenario, including (as a first idea of topics):

  • Transport of all safe/easily transportable items out of the country (if necessary)
  • Security and Safety of Location SCPs and other objects that cannot be transferred out of America
  • Dealing with the remnants of the UIU
  • Complex supply lines during large scale societal collapse including the failure of vital infrastructure
  • Diplomacy with Federal government to maintain neutrality and peace
  • Preservation of the veil and acquisition of objects with the collapse of centralized communication

Following each of these points, there will be a short comment section from several researchers with approving and dissenting opinions on the proposal to 'solve' them. This is to make sure the article does not feel final or absolute, as it is a contingency plan in constant change, and to break up the walls of text that essays are prone to.

Hook: The Foundation is incredibly America-centric. Due to America's influence and incredible stability over the last 100 years, having a huge portion of Foundation sites in the USA has never been a problem. If that were to change, dealing with it would be a massive logistical problem that would require huge adaption by sites and operations both inside the US and worldwide.

item.title: Head of Life
item.description: What if you had a tiny world on top of your head?
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: An scp that consists of two entities. The primary entity is a man in his late 30s that seems completely normal. The second entity is an entire prehistoric ecosystem on top of his head hidden amongst his hair

Central Narrative: The scp would of first been discovered after agents stationed at a hospital as a doctor reported to the foundation a boy at age 10 who was brought in due to a strange ‘itch’ on his head that didn’t seem to go away. Upon examining the child's head, the agent discovered tiny creatures walking around on the kids head. What was first thought of as simply being lice was quickly disproven when on closer examination of one of the tiny creatures revealed a more reptilian-like appearance. After this discovery the child was taken to the foundation and observed with periodic removal of several of the tiny entities to be studied away from the environment. As the kid grows up the ecosystem changes in a similar manner to how ours have as evolution takes place and the scp, now in his late 30s, has entities on his head with similar intelligence as cavemen.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: Instead of just simply tiny dinosaurs, mammoths, and neanderthals running around on this guys head, the creatures evolving on this tiny ecosystem is completely unique in appearance ranging from creatures with the body shape of a ankylosaurus but a leech/lamprey-like mouth used to suck nutrients from the scalp to flat gliding creatures that glide from hair strand to hair strand latching on and feeding off the follicle. As time goes on and the guy ages the entities change until they reach the stone age when he hits 30

Additional Notes: the man has pretty much grown use to having these things frolicking around his head but still expresses a desire to just be able to be normal along with thinking whatever these tiny things are think that he’s their god despite foundation scientists telling him that there has not been any evidence of any entity on his head showing any knowledge of the mans existence.

item.title: Seeking Greenlight: “Patient Zero”
item.description: A little something I’ve been working on. SCP-5968, or “Patient Zero”
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlight: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Fiction

Elevator Pitch: SCP-5968 is an anomalous humanoid who has a strange immunity to the effects of some of the foundation’s most dangerous SCP’s and has shown the ability of nullifying the anomalous properties of said SCP’s. They are not anomalous in any ways other than immunity and nullification. No super strength; no super intelligence; no super powers.

Central Narrative: Numerous addendums describing studies and tests involving SCP-5968’s interactions with and reactions to other SCP’s. Some data is still in progress, and the storyline for INCIDENT-5968/H is TBD.

Hook/Attention Grabber: SCP-5968 is both one of the most helpful, and most dangerous, anomalies at the foundation. We know how he is helpful, but what makes him so dangerous?

item.title: Seeking greenlights (Ghost Rider)
item.description: Here is my idea for the SCP ghost rider
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes
Page Type: SCP Article
Genre: Horror
Elevator Pitch: My idea of the SCP is vehicle with an unusually loud motor driven by Dr. Danny from around from midnight till sunrise. Doctor Danny drives in unpopulated areas with a very loud sound that reaches houses miles away, which explains the very loud motor sound we many times hear in our houses, that seems so far yet very close. If an unlucky individual happens to see Dr. Danny driving, he will do whatever he can in his will to run over that individual. Due to Doctor Danny's dementia he will forget about everyone who saw him driving the past days, but will continue to drive each midnight of evey day. It is yet to be discovered as to why Dr. Danny only drives at night, but many people speculate it to be the effect of "Sun-downing" that effects Dimentia patients it. The car is never seen during the day, as if its only created at night
Central Narrative: The story starts when a Doctor called Danny Frank, suffering from Dimentia lived in the middle of nowhere, yet every time from midnight till sunrise he can hear a loud vehicle driving in the distance. One day before midnight he waited outside for the car to drive, and acted as a hitchhiker. Danny ended up killing the man driving it and parking it on the side of the rode in this big unpopulated empty grass area around his home. The next day at midnight when Danny went to sleep he never heard the sound of the car again, yet he did not remember sleeping each day before, which he thought to be an effect of his Dimentia. If an individual saw Dr. Danny driving the doctor will try to run over the individual, but will stop at sunrise because he only drives the car from midnight till sunrise. The main cause of him driving at night is yet to be discovered but it is speculated to be the effect of Dimentia's Sun-downing effect on patients. The motor in the car is very different than any in other vehicles, having the ability to produce a very high sound. Both Dr. Danny and the vehicle are yet to be contained by the foundation.
Hook/Attention Grabber: Many times when sleeping you can hear a vehicle driving with a loud sound in the middle of the night, that might make you confused or scared. The sound always seems too far yet too close! This vehicle is the car that produces that sound, try to stay away from the sound and do not look outside the window if you hear it.
